Description

INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA placeholder register. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA command summary. This register exists only to publish a SOC_USB_OCP_RECOVERY_INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA address symbol and to anchor the offset in the aperture map; the live byte-mux and pointer-update logic live in usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv.

[31:0] DATA rw 0x0 FIFO data placeholder

Field Descriptions

DATA - FIFO data placeholder

DWORD placeholder for INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA. usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv is the live payload owner and mirrors the current pop word back through hw=w. The access event bridges to the live FIFO data path rather than creating a second payload owner. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA command summary.
